description: Check whether an AI agent should pay a pay-per-request (x402) seller, using TWZRD Agent Intel's free checks. Get an allow, warn or block verdict before paying, read a seller's track record, spot wash trading (sellers paying themselves to look busy), browse paid services and marketplace listings, keep a block list of flagged wallets up to date, and score the wallets agents pay from. Mostly Solana, with some Base.
